name: ACM SIG Conference (CCF-A: SIGGRAPH / MobiCom / CHI …)
description: ACM SIG 系列双栏会议模板。强调 ACM Computing Classification、CCS Concepts、Keywords 索引。

chapter_plan.title: Abstract
requirements: 150-200 words
CCS Concepts: 至少 1-3 个
Keywords: 3-5 个

chapter_plan.title: 1 Introduction
requirements: Motivation + gap + 我们的方法 + 关键贡献
与本文工作配套的 demo video / supplementary URL（如有）

chapter_plan.title: 2 Related Work
requirements: 与本文最相关的 1-3 类工作对比

MUST engage with systemic-risk network models (SDECM + DebtRank/NEVA), diffusion-spectral contagion, ABM/dynamic-graph contagion, system-dynamics housing models, empirical identification around implicit guarantees / central supervision (when relevant)

chapter_plan.title: 3 Method / System Design
requirements: System overview diagram + 各组件细节
数学/算法推导（视会议风格）
RIGOR: causal identification or explicit identified-vs-assumed split; address endogeneity
RIGOR: hierarchical/panel heterogeneity (regions/banks/firms), not aggregates only; report dispersion
RIGOR: endogenous feedback loop (credit supply -> demand -> prices) with direction/magnitude justification
RIGOR: network loss-propagation layer (DebtRank / SDECM / diffusion-spectral PDE / TGNN) when systemic risk is central
RIGOR: document all parameter priors, distributions, correlations

chapter_plan.title: 4 Implementation
requirements: 软件栈、硬件、关键工程决策
RIGOR: parameter priors / covariance matrix; distribution families; correlations; random seeds; code/release plan

chapter_plan.title: 5 Evaluation
requirements: 实验环境、基线、metric、结果
Case study / user study / 性能基准
RIGOR: out-of-sample backtest with RMSE/MAE/CRPS for forecasting/scenario engines
RIGOR: comparison against >=5 baselines incl. established systemic-risk/network models (DebtRank/SDECM, diffusion-spectral, ABM)
RIGOR: ablation (>=3 components) + sensitivity tornado + heterogeneity decomposition by region/portfolio
RIGOR: report std/CI over multiple seeds for ALL numbers

chapter_plan.title: 6 Discussion
requirements: Limitations + 未来工作
RIGOR: honest limitations (NPL recognition, restructuring, off-balance-sheet channels); artifact description / reproducibility statement

chapter_plan.title: 7 Conclusion
requirements: 简短总结

chapter_plan.title: References
requirements: ACM 引用格式 (numeric, square brackets)

chapter_plan.title: Appendix
requirements: 可选

RIGOR: full code listing / repository URL, complete parameter priors / covariance matrix, distribution families, correlations, random seeds, reconciliation tables for constructed quantities, artifact description

system_prompt:
You are an expert researcher writing a paper for ACM SIG conferences (CCF-A: SIGGRAPH, MobiCom, CHI, SOSP, OSDI, etc.).

[FORMAT — STRICT]
- Use acmart document class in sigconf mode (two-column, 10pt).
- Page limit: 6-14 main pages.
- Include CCS Concepts (ACM Computing Classification) and Keywords right after the abstract.
- Sections in order: Abstract (with CCS Concepts + Keywords) → 1 Introduction → 2 Related Work → 3 Method / System Design → 4 Implementation → 5 Evaluation → 6 Discussion → 7 Conclusion → References → Appendix.

[WRITING RULES]
1. Abstract: 150-200 words. State the problem, method, and the strongest result.
2. CCS Concepts: 1-3 entries from https://dl.acm.org/ccs (e.g., 'Computing methodologies → Machine learning').
3. Keywords: 3-5 specific terms.
4. Introduction: motivate with a concrete user-facing or system scenario. State contributions as bullets.
5. Method: include a system overview figure (or describe it). For each component, give a paragraph + (optional) algorithm box.
6. Evaluation: report setup, baselines, metrics, and results. For system papers include throughput / latency / scalability curves.
7. Discussion: enumerate limitations and reflect on broader impact / ethical considerations.

[TONE]
Concrete, system-oriented, and benchmark-driven. Avoid speculative claims.

[CITATIONS]
ACM numeric: [1], [2, 3].

[OUTPUT FORMAT]
Return a single JSON object (no prose outside JSON) with keys: title, abstract, keywords (list[str]), ccs_concepts (list[str]), latex_code, sections (dict[str, str]).

rigor_checklist: 必须提供因果识别或显式区分'已识别'与'假设'部分
必须包含样本外回测/验证并报告 RMSE/MAE/CRPS
必须对比基线，含系统性风险/网络基线（DebtRank/SDECM、扩散谱、ABM）
必须做消融实验（>=3 个组件）与敏感性分析（tornado）
必须建模异质性（层级/面板），报告跨单元离散度
必须编码内生反馈环，用 SVAR/结构块验证方向与量级
系统性风险为内核时必须加网络损失传染层并与聚合块对比
必须形式化所有构造量，给出对账表
必须公开完整代码、参数先验/协方差、随机种子（artifact description）
必须陈述局限与未来工作
